scope: VCFv4.5 table VCF5.1 and its character encoding, control-character, line-ending and percent-encoding rules.

VCFv4_1.note: This is a section/table scan finding only; it does not establish that no general encoding behavior exists elsewhere.

VCFv4_2.note: This is a section/table scan finding only; it does not establish that no general encoding behavior exists elsewhere.

rules_in_v4_3_plus.rule: Disallowed non-printable code points U+0000–U+0008, U+000B–U+000C, U+000E–U+001F
Line separators CR+LF or LF only at end of line
Characters with special field-delimiter meaning must be percent-encoded for other meanings, using capitalized hex

mapping_table.comparison: The eight mappings are textually unchanged across VCFv4.3, VCFv4.4 and VCFv4.5 in the reviewed source ranges.
